answer.answer: Northstar did not remove policy checks; they were renamed. The Northstar 4 migration guide states that Northstar 4 renames 'policy checks' to 'release guards' and that their purpose is unchanged [northstar-policy-new]. The Northstar 3 guide confirms the prior terminology: 'Northstar 3 calls pre-deployment controls policy checks' [northstar-policy-old]. So the controls persist under a new name; nothing in the supplied sources indicates removal.
change_events: Northstar 4 renames 'policy checks' to 'release guards'; their purpose is unchanged [northstar-policy-new].
current_truths: In Northstar 4, pre-deployment controls are called 'release guards'; the prior 'policy checks' term was renamed, not removed [northstar-policy-new].
historical_truths: In Northstar 3, pre-deployment controls were called 'policy checks' [northstar-policy-old].
unresolved: The sources state the purpose is unchanged but do not detail any behavioral or configuration differences beyond the rename [northstar-policy-new].
